title: What qteasy-ai is
summary: qteasy-ai is the assistant on top of qteasy: Ask explains, Plan shows steps, and Agent runs only after you confirm.
narrative:
qteasy-ai is the built-in assistant that sits on qteasy. It explains the toolkit, drafts reviewable plans, and runs those plans only after you confirm. It is not a second backtest engine and it does not replace the qteasy library.

The numbers below name the next windows. A later question may refer to a number; explain that item from its card.

1. Three modes. Ask is read-only Q&A. Plan shows a ToolPlan and waits. Agent (run) executes after confirmation. Live-trade steps stay plan-only.
2. Web workbench. Switch Ask, Plan, and Agent with the composer mode badge. Confirm is optional, and Ask never clicks it.
3. CLI and Notebook. The qteasy-ai command line and the notebook magic share one session_id.
4. Knowledge. Ask reads only the packaged official cards. A local user_kb scaffold is not mixed into those answers.
5. What does not happen by itself. High-side-effect steps need a visible plan. Ask alone does not download, backtest, or send an order.

What qteasy the library is, as distinct from this assistant, is a separate product card.
python_code:
from qteasy_ai.app import QteasyAssistant
assistant = QteasyAssistant()
print(assistant.ask('什么是 qteasy-ai', response_style='raw')['sources'])
risk_notes: Ask never downloads data, runs a backtest, or sends an order. Plan waits for confirmation before high-side-effect work.
